nextSlice.title: Add observable large-batch UX and team-readable exports
scope: Expose explicit pending, running, progress, cancelling, completed, and failed states in the native Chinese panel
Provide a user cancellation entry point while preserving the existing between-batch cancellation contract
Generate deterministic Chinese HTML and UTF-8 CSV handoff artifacts from the versioned Report without rescanning assets
Include Profile identity, host version, summary, issues, evidence, collection failures, and validation boundary in the handoff package
Extend fixtures, tests, real host lifecycle evidence, tutorial, recording flow, and current screenshots
nonGoals: No cloud service, external database, user account, notification, or telemetry upload
No asset mutation or automatic repair
No claim that synchronous Editor work is non-blocking until independently measured
No automatic CI gate in this slice
No compatibility claim beyond hosts actually tested
validationCommands: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check Content/Python Demo/Scripts tests scripts
nextSlice.evidenceCeiling: Fixtures may prove export determinism; BuildPlugin may prove compilation; only a fresh independent Unreal host lifecycle may prove panel task-state and cancellation wiring. RenderOffscreen evidence does not prove human mouse interaction or absence of Editor stalls.
acceptance: The panel exposes understandable task state, bounded progress, and an honest between-batch cancellation action
Cancellation preserves already completed batches and produces a valid partial Report
Chinese HTML and UTF-8 CSV exports are deterministic and readable without Unreal Editor
Exports trace every issue to observed and expected evidence and clearly label fixture versus real-host provenance
A fresh independent Unreal host lifecycle validates task states and exports without touching existing user sessions
README, Demo tutorial, recording script, and screenshots show the large-batch and handoff workflow

Eight current-version 1280x688 Slate screenshots cover empty, mixed, pass, issue, filtered evidence, and failure states; hashes are recorded in the M4 host evidence manifest.
UE 5.8.1 dev3 collected collision and Lightmap facts for four Engine Static Meshes; all source asset SHA-256 values remained unchanged.
Eight v0.5 production Slate screenshots cover the expanded ledger plus collision and Lightmap evidence; hashes are recorded in the M5 manifest.
v0.6 added real project-owned naming and directory faults, three fresh UE reports, a clean UE 5.8.1 BuildPlugin, ten production Slate screenshots, and a structured isolated PID lifecycle record.

v0.7 preserves immutable same-Profile sessions, compares new/persistent/resolved/failure changes, packages two real UE reports, passes UE 5.8.1 BuildPlugin, and renders twelve current Slate screenshots in an isolated lifecycle.
